items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Billy Eckstine, Lena Horne, Georgia Auld, Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong. I mean the works. That opening night was terrific.

ctx.x: When was he working for them? Oh, you mean his son?
No, Billy himself was in Gale Agency. He didn't have Shaw Agency then.
